newsitem.title: GERMANY: Thyssen non-core divs lost 220 mln DM.
newsitem.headline: Thyssen non-core divs lost 220 mln DM.

text.p: Germany's largest steel maker Thyssen AG said on Friday it had lost 220 million marks in 1995/96 in non-core businesses of little strategic importance.

The company said earlier it would undertake a restructuring to shed non-core businesses and focus on core activities. Core businesses alone turned a profit of one billion marks on sales of 26 billion marks, a company spokesman said.
"This shows clearly the solid substance of the core activities," the spokesman said.
The non-core businesses had sales of about five billion marks and employ about 11,000 workers, he said.
For the year ended September 30, the company showed a net profit of 350 million marks, down from 775 million the year before.
Sales totaled 38.7 billion marks, down from 39.1 billion.
